notes.title: February Content Update
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

This is the first [b]Major Content Update [/b]for 2022, it's a little earlier than expected but there were some performance improvements and dire needed bug fixes that we needed to push a month early. This update comes with the new Male Jackal form a new Quest to aid a village, a huge array of bug fixes and a UI Overhaul.

[h2]First Non-Human Male[/h2]

You can now stride over the sands with the likeness of Anubis as this update brings with it the first non-human male form to the game; the Jackal. Unlock this by completing Diamond in the Rough along with the Female Jackal form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/bb58f8360dcca8068dcee395f1f9faa1cbc9d62c.png[/img]

[h1]Save/Load Changes[/h1]

We have made major changes to the Saving system, streamlining it further and optimizing the way it loads the core dialog and quest system which in our tests has proven to be a dramatic improvement for those players who were having the worst issues. We upgraded this system during the winter winds update and despite this being a general improvement for most, some players had it worse than ever and we had to address this immediately. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/6a465fbadae2a9836940d9fd5758e52d7022c68e.png[/img]

Despite this improvements and their backwards compatibility, we would always for the Major Content Updates recommend that you start a new save and we have added a new warning message in-game when you attempt to load an old save to show you all this. You will not be able to complete new content on old saves for most, if not all, major content updates until the map and core systems are completed.


[h1]UI Overhaul[/h1]

We spent a lot of time this update working on our inventory management system, now each slot is selectable and has it's own tab for you to select your equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/442c84baca065c2b09997e1d18940eb96d49ad6f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/6d2cd9d92bc7db6e1affd28c727f16b30b4f167c.png[/img]

[h3]Dialog UI Improvements[/h3]
During Dialog, you can now use the Keyboard keys 1,2,3,4 etc to choose dialog choices and spacebar to skip or select choices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/d645dbc83bb4ad39f8e9157831f818e3ef596d4e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/4d598a818bdb40c8ee5da5803c447715ac323826.png[/img]

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]

We're very aware that we've been creeping up in performance requirements lately and so this update we did a bit of spring cleaning early! We've boosted FPS and lowered CPU usage across the board by optimization in dialog cameras, NPCs roaming around the world, textures, particles and more!  

We're always working on continually improving the performance in the game and we're currently prototyping some much more radical changes.


[h2]Combat[/h2]
We've changed our targeting system, moving back to our previous system with dynamic targeting. We felt that managing two combat targeting systems(which is what we had) ended up being messy and not what we intended; now we're focusing on polishing and making one system. Additionally, a change some of you will notice is that thrust attack is now sprint + regular attack rather than having it's own keybind.

We're currently working on incorporating magic into the combat system this will be coming later this year with it's own quest. Ranged upgrades and improvements are also on the way with bow crafting, arrows and some changes to enemy behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/89b1c005511f329f2ee3b45de365d980ee68312f.png[/img]

[h2]Squish goes the Bug[/h2]
We've tried our best to go through as many bugs we could find in the update and fix as many as we can in time for the update, including issues with Milk and Honey, Quest tracking, day/night issues, fast travel, NPCs, animations, typos, save/load issues and more! Check out the full change log below and we hope you now have a smoother experience all round!


[h2]New Clothing[/h2]
We've added new clothing this update with the Sabuthi Sash & Sabuthi Skirt, two new clothing options that can be mixed-and-matched with the Anubite garments. The clothing itself will be common among NPCs once the overhaul drops in the coming weeks, normal garb for the rank and file citizenry. Not originally intended to be available for Players *yet*, these are hot off the press (so some clipping with extreme morphs may occur). Currently there are four colour options, though patterned versions and some variants without the bikini are incoming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/918843c4b3d7e94701ff5a5915176656b76d68be.png[/img]

[h2]New Quest[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/3c389b0dfb12fca73adc8ff87b11363ecd8f1621.png[/img]

In addition to fixing up our existing content, this update isn't without a new quest [b]"No Rest for the Wicked"[/b] sees the player decide the fate of a village, a last glimmer of hope against the rising darkness of the curse. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/ca721b4094439de8e48fe4b3a1755325ea0cf5ef.png[/img]

A new weapon comes along with this quest, [b]The Kethrite Sceptre[/b] For now this item is merely a unique melee weapon. For now...


[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

So, what's next in-development? Well for those that missed it, we're currently working on the Dynamic Sex System. This new mechanic is intended to dramatically increase the number of characters with whom you can engage in sex acts, whilst at the same time improving the quality of the scenes themselves. Camera control, speed, even changing the intensity or style of the act - the Dynamic Sex System should help ground the adult content in the world and make it far more interactive.
We'll also be adding more quests, an ever expanding map and working on more core systems ready for Alpha this year.


[i][h3]We're looking forward to bringing you more content and updates this year and we hope you all have a great 2022, thank you all for your support, there's more to come.[/h3][/i]

notes.title: Major Content Update - Winter Winds
notes.notes:
[h1]V0.3.22 Major Steam Content Update and Bug Fixes[/h1]

Hey Everyone!

This is the last [b]Major Content Update[/b] for 2021, though there will be plenty more to come throughout 2022. It's a chunky amount of content however, with new quests, NPCs, adult content, crafting, and a sackful of bugfixes to boot.

[h2]Winter Winds[/h2]

Our new seasonal content features the addition of a huge new 'Extreme Exotic NPC' in the form of an [b]Ancient Dragon[/b] (yes, she has adult content). This massive addition to the world isn't just for Christmas though, she's integral to a side story that we'll continue to develop in the coming months. For now she has only a single scene (it's repeatable), but this will expand over time.

[previewyoutube=hm0gxVy2aTA;full][/previewyoutube]

As part of the Winter Winds content, players can also now craft the Frost-Forged Weapons. Currently these are a damage upgrade on the lower tier, however we'll be adding elemental effects to these (and other unique items) in time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/921527ef19244865d2e6357a2889bd2249bdd415.png[/img]

[h2]Looking Good[/h2]

As we work towards remaking the clothing to be compatible with the customisation system, we've entirely remade our [b]Anubite Warriors[/b]. We're aiming to make all our new content to this much higher standard, as we try to bring the look of the game as close to AAA as possible for a 5-person indie team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/ac1349c06694156fb31a46218757a17b8124f9fb.png[/img]

Not only are our new Anubites more detailed as NPCs, but all of the garments are usable to the player - you can even mix and match the head, chest, and lowerbody sections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/285d58d3b97096d22f99f252b2866300a988227f.png[/img]


[h2]Playable Races[/h2]

It wouldn't be a major update without a new species to explore the world with. To this end we've added the new [b]Female Jackal[/b] form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/5ce92350a5d92c4da9a02cf936539377853fd774.png[/img]

Our Demi-Human races (Hybrids) have also been reintroduced to the game, so the 'Egyptian Deity' aesthetic is once more a playable option. All these and the new Jackal forms are entirely compatible with the customisation, so play with those sliders to your heart's content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/f24f470d0690513ac2a99f4b6b13f72e692ce886.png[/img]

[h2]New Quests[/h2]

This update brings with it another new, voice-acted quest, on top of the one included as part of the Winter Winds content. [b]Law & Order[/b] Tasks you with tracking down a thief who has been plaguing the markets by the docks, something the Merchant's Guild is none too happy about. This of course means more NPCs, so we're also introducing the NPC-only [b]Minoan[/b] race in this update. Not every species is elegant and athletic, these hulking brutes are far more interested in counting their profits than in gallivanting about, as you'll discover in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/925652f0c1d612dc6a88533c408cf679edb9071e.png[/img]

[h2]Bringing the World to Life[/h2]

Various new tweaks have also taken place with the world, from adjustments to lighting to the addition of new ambient particles. As you wander through flower fields you'll now see butterflies fluttering past, dirt tracks will have dusct and sand kicked up by the wind. Generally the world has a little more visual polish to give it that living, breathing feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/e18a4948195548ccb871f8ac633577709620b5a4.png[/img]

[h2]I'm Horny[/h2]

The missing horns are back! No longer will Dhasha troll you with a trek across the entire map only to give you sweet nothing as a reward. The reworked [b]Northern Horns[/b] are once again a cosmetic item in-game. Did this warrant a section all to itself? Possibly not. Am I going to devote this entire section to it anyway? Who the hell is going to stop me... [i]mwhahahAHAHAH![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/101ffaed7ac6eb6bac2a8e95d01fe89e22a468c8.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Hunt[/h2]

From terrain glitches to [b]that $%£?&@# save issue[/b], we've been tracking down the rarest and juciest nasties we could lay our hands on. It's still pre-alpha, it's still not perfect, but it should be [i]far more stable.[/i]

[h2]The Best of What's Left[/h2]

From cooking to new voice acting, there's a load more that's changed than we can detail in full - check out the patchnotes below for a full rundown of the new content/changes in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/cfbb3e67a5b1ffca2158b51f7ca963500beb0697.png[/img]


[b][h3]Thank You[/h3][/b]

From all five of us, have a wonderful Christmas and a Happy New year. We'll be back with the next major update before you know it, thank you again for your incredible support.

notes.title: Major Content Update + Halloween Items
notes.notes:
[h1]v0.3.14 Major Steam Content Update, Halloween Bonus Items, and Bug Fixes[/h1]

Hey Everyone!

We're here at last with a [b]Major Content Update[/b] for Steam ahead of the [b]Christmas Update[/b] which will mark the last major update on Steam for 2021 (we have a tonne of content planned for 2022).  Those of you that follow our Discord news will already be aware that one of our team was injured in a violent attack that put us behind for a month or so, they've now recovered and the spade with which they were attacked has been immortalised in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/0774b09fb00e34d429f7e7aecc2a75d5d8d726ed.png[/img]

The bulk of this update is fleshing out the art, world, and systems to enable the next phase of the main story. This does mean that there isn't any new major quest content in this update, though some such as [b]Milk & Honey[/b] have a few alternative options along the way.


[h2]Halloween Content[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Accursed Tales[/b]
Sit beside the campfire to discover a further secret of the kingdom's past. Use your newfound knowledge to search for the other Halloween content or perhaps avoid the dangers altogether...

[*] [b]New 'Cursed Felian' Playable Race[/b]
Stride across the sands of Sabu in a body that has almost totally succumbed to the Curse of Kethra.

[*] [b]Member of Pure Essence[/b]
Equip yourself with a manhood forged from the souls of those poor unfortunates that fell to the God Queen's Curse.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/4b64460acd409f52c6e109476bb771ae938b3baa.png[/img]


[h2]Character Customisation[/h2]

We have undertaken a visual overhaul of our player models, with both Felians and Draconids sporting all-new models. Our beautiful cat-girls now look far less like teddybears than they previously did.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DXLdSGD.gif[/img]

You can now pick your starting sex and ethnicity from the very start of the game, with new forms, skins, and details unlocking as you discover them in the world. You can shape your body, from breast size to bodyfat and other options besides. This does mean that unfortunately [b]most clothing is not compatible with the new system[/b] and will not be usable yet in-game, this will be updated and [b]the clothing will added back with a BONUS update to Steam[/b], in addition to the usual release schedule.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/5c66621962ead9b6d6235d2998340b7290271785.png[/img]

The available species are currently limited to [b]Humans[/b] (Male, Female, Futa), [b]Draconids[/b] (Female, Futa), [b]Felians[/b] (Female, Futa), and [b]Cursed Felians[/b] (Female, Futa). Due to incompatibility with the new customisation system the Demi-Humans (human/anthro hybrids) have been [u]temporarily[/u] removed but will be added back in a subsequent patch.

The next major update at Christmas will bring [b]Canines[/b] to the world of Carnal Instinct, with Jackals making their first appearance (without a mask at least).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/fe3023214cda919cf3f964e36f6f75fd64d7f093.png[/img]
[i][Work in Progress - Female Jackal Sculpt][/i]


[h2]Combat Upgrades[/h2]

You can now face your foes with [b]daggers[/b], [b]longswords[/b], [b]spears[/b], and [b]a spade[/b]. Combat has receieved countless upgrades including soft-lock, assassinations and much much more. Be warned, a bug with enemy awareness has been fixed so [b]they can now attack you from behind![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rZx2hFr.gif[/img]


[h2]More Goo-d Stuff[/h2]

Carnal Instinct isn't just about the gameplay, you also need to be able to [i]unwind[/i]. To this end there's a new scene that seems particularly appropriate to the Halloween timing of the update; the [b]Primal Goo Girl encounter[/b]. If you've previously discovered the goo tentacles but not found a use for them (other than the obvious) then you're now in luck. By taking the captured goo to a particularly disreputable slave trader you're able to have it combine with her... before [i]"combining"[/i] with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/e24c8419427c62c437829b1486a87ff1adbf3700.png[/img]


[h2]Camp & Crafting System[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CbcNj7l.gif[/img]

The Player Camp has finally arrived, enabling you to now begin customising your new home. For now this is limited to a small range of building and decorative options but the available upgrades will expand over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/b3e46e789b4b2a1a8f41767d54606d0d7a25f72c.png[/img]

The Camp also opens up the possibilites of crafting, both weapons and consumables. Many ingredients can now be discovered in the world, either from merchants or the bodies of fallen foes. These items combine at the [b]Weaponsmith[/b] and [b]Alchemist[/b] to enable the creation of very valuable items including powerful weapons.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4GIbVqW.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/fddfaf211135eb0ea9d1e4ca1a3e8144b126fe30.png[/img]


[h2]Prison Break[/h2]

You arrive at your camp, animal skulls and metal ingots in hand, but where is the Weaponsmith to craft your mighty spear? Well he's locked up in a cage somewhere. One of the new features we've added is [b]Caged Prisoner Encounters[/b]. For now these are just used to recruit the two tradespeople for the camp, but as we move forward they'll play into quests both big and small.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/cc91bccfa9c672b356c19afae8daac325f763958.png[/img]


[h2]Enriched & Expanded World[/h2]

A large amount of our world was essentially placeholder - we're a 5-person team and there's just too much for us to handle in one go. That said we've radically overhauled and improved the map, both in terms of visual quality and also believability. There's now a better flow to many areas of the map, as well as additional places to find loot and encounter enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/648bc3b4a85415edfc8f8a88ef85abdb4f722156.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/4f41dd159515a7a84eb31d303f6ea47064f773cc.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/aeffd7e0486705313d4150b103c43ddf20729a26.png[/img]


[h2]Improved Animation[/h2]

We're now making use of Performance Capture in our sex scenes and other content, with numerous examples already implemented in this build of the game we're using this technology to greatly increase the fidelity we're able to achieve in cutscenes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/B9B87W0.gif[/img]


[h2]Game Difficulty & Content Preferences[/h2]

You can now select your preferred [b]game difficulty[/b] and [b]sex content preferences[/b] in the menu. Thi allows you to disable Male/Male, Female/Female, or any other content combination (the NPCs will still be in the world but you won't be able to engage with them sexually).

[h2]Using a Controller to Play Carnal Instinct[/h2]

We don't yet support controllers (support for this is in development) however if you are going to use a controller we highly recommend using a steam input profile to do so. You can access this setting here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/2e4e83921df19bce4ebda32b12647e3f037eb6de.png[/img]


[h2]Plans & Future Development[/h2]

Our previous roadmap has now been revised based upon several votes put to the community. [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EGL7Z5N6SXVJDNxl8BVEERKETws3AM3lMtcXUQKFg2M/edit?usp=sharing]The updated roadmap is available here[/url]. [b]Please be aware that the months represent when said content will go to playtest, [u]not[/u] be condition that is ready to ship.[/b] As usual major updates will drop [u]at least[/u] once every three months, with regular additional bugfix updates and other content drops throughout the year.


[h3]Thank You[/h3]

[i]From all of us at Team Carnal Instinct, thank you for your support, there's more to come.[/i]

[h1]UPDATE SCHEDULE & PLAYTEST CONTENT[/h1]

There has been a lot of confusion as to when/how the update schedule will work between crowdfunded playtest builds and the Steam version of Carnal Instinct. Likewise, some misinformation has been doing the rounds that we feel needs dispelling.

Due to the Steam T&Cs we cannot delve too far into the specifics of the funded playtest builds on this platform, however you are more than welcome to [url=https://discord.gg/8q6qhZK9rK]join our Discord server[/url].. We're entirely open about our development model and more than happy to answer any questions you may have.

What we can say is that we're a small team and we rely on the controlled, monthly playtests to test content, provide initial feedback, and attempt hotfixes. This is not to say we'll never reach the point that this is synchronous with Steam, but currently it's not feasible for our team size.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39368406/fc107c6b40cabab03e6a8ae798612d482e4dc2c8.png[/img]

We had to choose between the updates being [b]small & frequent[/b] or [b]substantial & stable[/b]. Our team is split down the middle on which model we prefer as gamers, so we opted for the best of both worlds and provided both options across the available platforms. [b]As a Steam user you will get access to all major content updates [u]in the most stable state available[/u][/b].

With a [b]minimum of 4 major content updates[/b] annually, Carnal Instinct is substantially in advance of most Early Access titles on Steam and even ahead of some crowdfunded update schedules. If you're interested in what content is being developed over the coming months check out our roadmap below. Please note that this is subject to change as the team is about to become full-time on the project and therefore we'll be expanding the contents of the roadmap to match our new capacity.

[b][u]Please note:[/u] Based on community feedback we have simplified the roadmap below to match our intended 'Major' updates. The displayed content will be delivered within each calendar quarter as a major update or, in the case of Human Males, as a supplementary minor update in the period (Males will arrive on Steam in July). For full information, or to ask any questions you may have, please join our Discord using the link at the bottom of this post[i] (edited 15th June 2021)[/i].[/b]
